summary: Backcountry skier triggered a slide on Red Lady Bowl on Tuesday Jan 29 and self-extricated; he walked roughly 300 yards down to meet an ambulance and was reported to have potentially serious injuries; 911 call came in around 3 p.m. in blowing snow and low visibility
responding_agency: Crested Butte Search and Rescue + Crested Butte EMS
notes: Crested Butte News 2013-01-30; CBSAR president Nicholas Kempin was patrolling and did not respond directly; skier walked to the ambulance on his own
